l4_steps.name: Monitor flight disruption alerts
l4_steps.input: OTP delay/cancel alerts from airport ops or ATC; Altéa PSS flight status feed
l4_steps.output: Disruption event record opened in crew tracking system
l4_steps.kpi: Detection-to-action time ≤10 min; alert integration latency ≤5 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa PSS and Jeppesen do not sync in real-time; 5–15 min lag in crew impact visibility causes delayed recovery initiation

l4_steps.name: Classify disruption type and scope
l4_steps.system: Jeppesen Crew Management + SITA Airport Management System (AMS)
l4_steps.input: Flight status updates, weather NOTAMs, ATC delay codes
l4_steps.output: Disruption classification record: type (delay/cancel/divert), scope (isolated/systemic), affected flight list
l4_steps.pain_point: Weather-driven systemic disruptions affecting 50+ crew members simultaneously overwhelm manual classification; no automated severity scoring in Jeppesen

l4_steps.name: Extract affected crew roster
l4_steps.output: Affected crew list with current duty status, rest period elapsed, and home base
l4_steps.kpi: Roster extraction time ≤5 min; crew data accuracy ≥98%
l4_steps.pain_point: Crew position data lags if crew fail to check in via mobile app; roster inaccuracies force manual verification calls adding 10–20 min

l4_steps.name: Validate FAR Part 117 duty time status
l4_steps.input: Affected crew list; current cumulative duty times; rest period records
l4_steps.output: Compliance status matrix per crew member: legal / marginal / illegal with hours remaining
l4_steps.kpi: Duty time calculation accuracy 100%; 0 regulatory violations per post-flight audit
l4_steps.pain_point: FAR Part 117 augmented crew provisions and cumulative fatigue risk calculations are complex; manual overrides risk non-compliance and FAA enforcement action

l4_steps.name: Check crew qualifications and type ratings
l4_steps.input: Affected crew list; aircraft types on disrupted and recovery routes
l4_steps.output: Crew qualification match matrix; list of crew with type rating mismatches
l4_steps.kpi: Qualification verification ≤3 min per crew member; 0 unqualified crew assigned
l4_steps.pain_point: Narrowbody/widebody type rating mismatches restrict recovery options on mixed fleets; qualification database refresh latency causes stale records

l4_steps.name: Identify available reserve crew resources
l4_steps.input: Reserve crew duty board; crew availability calendar; standby call-out rules (CBA)
l4_steps.output: Available reserve crew list ranked by seniority, duty legality, and base proximity
l4_steps.kpi: Reserve utilization rate ≤85% to maintain buffer; reserve call-out success rate ≥90%
l4_steps.pain_point: Reserve pool depletion during systemic weather events; seniority-driven CBA bidding limits scheduling flexibility and overrides optimizer suggestions

l4_steps.name: Run automated re-pairing optimizer
l4_steps.input: Available crew pool (legal, qualified, available); disrupted pairing list; revised flight schedule
l4_steps.output: Proposed re-pairing solution set with cost scores and legality flags
l4_steps.kpi: Optimizer run time ≤8 min; automated solution coverage ≥95% of disrupted pairings
l4_steps.pain_point: Jeppesen optimizer produces sub-optimal solutions under tight time windows; cost parameter tuning requires experienced scheduler intervention to avoid excessive deadhead costs

l4_steps.name: Evaluate deadhead and positioning options
l4_steps.system: Jeppesen Crew Management + Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.input: Proposed re-pairing solution; available seat inventory on required flights
l4_steps.output: Deadhead bookings confirmed or rejected; adjusted re-pairing plan with positioning costs
l4_steps.kpi: Deadhead seat availability rate ≥70%; deadhead cost per re-pairing ≤$800
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated deadhead booking integration between Jeppesen and Altéa PSS; competing passenger demand on sold-out recovery flights blocks crew positioning

l4_steps.name: Apply manual overrides for exceptional cases
l4_steps.input: Optimizer solution gaps; exceptional crew constraints (compassionate leave, training conflicts)
l4_steps.output: Manually adjusted re-pairing with override justification log and authorisation code
l4_steps.kpi: Manual override rate ≤15% of total re-pairings; override documentation compliance 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual overrides are audit-tracked by labour unions and must be defensible under CBA; pressure to minimise them conflicts with operational necessity during major disruptions

l4_steps.name: Validate full re-pairing plan legality
l4_steps.input: Final re-pairing plan including all manual overrides
l4_steps.output: Legality validation report with pass/fail per assignment and FAR Part 117 reference citations
l4_steps.kpi: 100% compliance pass rate before plan activation; 0 post-departure duty violations
l4_steps.pain_point: Real-time legality checks may not capture late-reported duty changes; crew self-reporting of off-system duty time creates hidden violations discoverable only at post-flight audit

l4_steps.name: Assess CBA cost impact and premium pay flags
l4_steps.system: Jeppesen Crew Management + SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI/CO)
l4_steps.input: Approved re-pairing plan; crew pay rules from collective bargaining agreement
l4_steps.output: Estimated re-pairing cost vs. baseline pairing cost; premium pay flags (missed trip, deadhead, min-day guarantee)
l4_steps.kpi: Re-pairing cost premium ≤$1,200 per disrupted pairing; CBA rule flag accuracy ≥98%
l4_steps.pain_point: CBA minimum-day compensation, missed connection pay, and hotel expense rules trigger unexpected premium costs not modelled in Jeppesen; finance reconciliation with SAP is manual

l4_steps.name: Notify affected crew via CrewConnect and ACARS
l4_steps.system: Jeppesen CrewConnect mobile app + Telex/SITA ACARS
l4_steps.input: Finalised re-pairing assignments; crew contact details; estimated report times
l4_steps.output: Push notifications and duty change messages delivered; crew acknowledgment timer started
l4_steps.kpi: Notification delivery rate ≥98%; crew acknowledgment within 30 min for ≥85% of assignments
l4_steps.pain_point: Crew connectivity gaps in airports without WiFi; ACARS coverage limited to airborne crew; personal device management policy inconsistency across crew bases

l4_steps.name: Confirm crew acknowledgment and acceptance
l4_steps.input: Notification delivery confirmation; crew response (accept/reject with reason code)
l4_steps.output: Confirmed duty acceptance log or rejection record with CBA reason code
l4_steps.kpi: Crew acceptance rate on first notification ≥80%; escalation rate ≤20%
l4_steps.pain_point: Crew refusals citing CBA rest-period disputes or training conflicts require union liaison review before escalation; each dispute adds 20–40 min to recovery timeline

l4_steps.name: Escalate unresolved crew assignments
l4_steps.system: Jeppesen Crew Management + airline labour relations tracking system
l4_steps.input: Non-accepted assignment records; union contact roster; operational contingency options
l4_steps.output: Escalated case record; alternative crew sourced or operational contingency activated (delay/cancel flight)
l4_steps.kpi: Escalation resolution time ≤60 min; crew replacement sourced within 90 min of escalation
l4_steps.pain_point: Union grievance procedures can extend resolution beyond the operational window; documented escalation playbooks are inconsistent across crew bases and crew categories

l4_steps.name: Monitor re-pairing execution in real-time
l4_steps.system: Jeppesen Crew Management + SITA Airport Management System (AMS)
l4_steps.input: Live flight status updates; crew check-in confirmations; gate and stand assignments
l4_steps.output: Execution status dashboard with exception flags for late crew, missed check-ins, and gate conflicts
l4_steps.kpi: Re-pairing execution compliance rate ≥92%; real-time tracking lag ≤5 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Multi-airport simultaneous disruptions create monitoring overload; a single controller may track 20+ active re-pairings with no auto-escalation in Jeppesen for critical deviations

l4_steps.name: Update crew records and close disruption event
l4_steps.input: Completed re-pairing execution log; final duty times; hotel and transport receipts
l4_steps.output: Updated crew records (cumulative duty, pay events, pairing history); disruption closure report with root cause tag
l4_steps.kpi: Record update within 2 hours of final flight completion; data accuracy ≥99.5%; pay discrepancy rate ≤0.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Jeppesen-to-SAP SuccessFactors payroll integration latency causes pay discrepancies that generate crew queries and manual reconciliation effort averaging 45 min per affected pairing
